q: Do you provide quartz, granite and timber worktops?
a: Yes. We offer a full templating and installation service for luxury stone surfaces. Once your bespoke cabinets are installed by our team, our stone technicians visit to laser-template your surfaces. Your quartz or granite is then precision-cut in a factory environment and installed within 7–10 working days, including undermount sink cut-outs and drainer grooves.

q: Which appliance brands can I integrate into my design?
a: We work with all major appliance manufacturers, and supply and fit brands including Bosch, Neff, Siemens, AEG, Samsung and Rangemaster. We also fit Quooker boiling water taps and Elica extraction hobs, so your kitchen performs as well as it looks.

q: How long is the typical lead time from design to installation?
a: Because we make our own cabinetry in our Peterborough workshop, lead times are often much shorter than national retailers. Typically, installation begins 4–6 weeks after the final design is signed off, and the installation itself takes 1–2 weeks depending on the plumbing and electrics.

q: Do I need to organise my own plumber or electrician?
a: No. We provide a complete service with one point of contact. Our team includes expert fitters, Gas Safe registered plumbers and NICEIC certified electricians, and we handle everything from removals and waste disposal to the final coat of paint.

q: Can you handle structural changes or plastering?
a: Yes. As part of our project management, we handle plastering, non-structural wall removal and flooring. For major structural changes that need lintels or building control, we work with trusted local contractors so your room is ready for your new furniture.

q: What materials are your cabinets made from?
a: We use materials from trusted partners such as Egger, Kronospan and Cleaf. Our standard cabinets are built from 18mm high-density MFC with solid back panels for extra rigidity. For in-frame designs, we combine solid timber and moisture-resistant MDF for longevity in a kitchen.

Every project we install comes with our minimum 12-month guarantee on the furniture we make and the installation. Doors, cabinets, hardware and appliances can also carry longer manufacturers’ warranties, depending on what you choose, and our team helps you register them.

q: Do you offer flexible finance or interest-free credit?
a: Yes. We work with Ideal4Finance to offer monthly payment plans, including 0% interest-free credit (minimum spend £6,000 with a 50% deposit, subject to status) and longer-term credit. Speak to our team for a no-obligation quote.
